name: Auriferous-Firth

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by petrified remnants of a former biosphere and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
